name: Quick Jab
description: A lightning-fast baseline strike that costs no momentum, allowing the user to seamlessly transition into remaining movement.

name: Shield Prod
description: Deals minor blunt damage and nudges an adjacent target 1 tile back to clear an escape lane. Unless there is no room.

name: Hamstring Cut
description: A shallow blade stroke aimed at the legs, applying a minor 1-turn movement reduction.

name: Step-Aside Strike
description: Strikes the target and automatically forces the user to step 1 tile diagonally backward (if possible), breaking contact.

name: Feinting Lunge
description: A deceptive thrust that lowers the target's physical evasion stat for the duration of the current turn.

name: Dirty Sand Kick
description: Kicks ground debris into the target's eyes, dealing token damage and inflicting a mild accuracy penalty.

name: Grip Loosen
description: Targets the enemy's weapon arms, slightly decreasing their outgoing physical damage for 1 turn.

name: Crescent Strike
description: A heavy attack that always does consistent high damage.

name: Pity Pity
description: Use on a weak target if you want them to stay living.

name: Hop
description: Allows the unit to move 1 space forward ignoring terrain height.
